script_text: Something volatile stirs as Mars ignites your fiery core, Aries. Mid-week, the turning point arrives as Saturn forms a supportive sextile to your 4th House, stabilizing home and security. By Thursday, Venus’s conjunction with your 7th House ruler boosts love, helping you negotiate balance with a partner, yet finances demand caution. Wednesday is your power day because Saturn’s sextile empowers your 4th House, and Friday is your worst day as Neptune clouds judgment in your 6th. Focus on pragmatic goals before reacting.
